notes: GST is 9% on almost all goods and services; only financial services, residential property sales and rents, digital payment tokens and investment precious metals are exempt (IRAS, PwC).
About 92% of everyday spending (excluding housing, energy and cars) is taxable once insurance and financial services are taken out (estimate), so GST is 0.92 × 9% / 1.09 = 7.6% of that spending.
Singapore has no customs tariffs on most goods; excise duties apply to alcohol, tobacco, motor vehicles and petrol.
